metric_definitions.causal_checked_positions: Number of nonpadding prefix-position comparisons in the first two diagnostic batches, capped at eight sequences each. Cutpoints are the union of boundaries before the second, middle and last observed events of each sampled sequence. Only rows with an observed future event contribute at a cutpoint. Future events are replaced by padding without shifting absolute positions. A position may contribute at multiple cutpoints. Uses evaluation-mode log2feats features.
metric_definitions.causal_nonfinite_positions: Checked comparisons containing a nonfinite feature in either representation; excluded from the violation-rate denominator. Positive counts indicate numerical failures.
metric_definitions.causal_prefix_violation_rate: Fraction of finite checked positions where any feature coordinate changes by more than 1e-5 + 1e-4 times its original absolute value after future masking. Positive values flag future dependence or numerical sensitivity for investigation. Zero is a limited sampled consistency check, not proof of causality or relevance. Null means no finite comparisons.
metric_definitions.causal_prefix_max_absolute_error: Maximum absolute feature-coordinate change over finite checked prefix positions. Scale-dependent; null means no finite comparisons. This checks augmented features when the trained compatibility view exposes them, without assuming an unimplemented residual branch, gate or text-support state exists.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine of sampled nonpadding item embeddings, mapped to [0,1]. 0.5 corresponds to mean cosine zero. This descriptive statistic does not establish representation collapse, recommendation quality or recommendation diversity. Null means fewer than two sampled embeddings.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit over finite, nonpadding training positions with distinct positive and negative IDs. Scale-dependent and sampler-dependent; not validation HR@10. Null means no finite observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of the same training logit margins; scale-dependent. Null means no finite observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of finite valid training pairs with negative logit strictly above positive logit; ties are excluded from this numerator. Null means no observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of finite valid training pairs with margin below 0.5 logit units. This threshold is scale-dependent. Null means no observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Category breakdown unavailable because item categories are not provided. Includes aggregate finite-pair counts below the margin thresholds only.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_observed_positions: Number of nonpadding training positions with distinct positive and negative IDs examined in at most ten loader batches, including nonfinite scores.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_finite_positions: Observed positions with two finite logits and a finite margin.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_nonfinite_positions: Observed positions excluded from margin summaries due to a nonfinite logit or margin; positive counts indicate numerical failures requiring investigation.
